svg.title: Cross a block boundary without publishing partial state
svg.desc: Toy: P = 3; B = 4; 128 bytes/position; scripted selections 20, 21, 22, EOS
svg.text: Cross a block boundary without publishing partial state
Toy: P = 3; B = 4; 128 bytes/position; scripted selections 20, 21, 22, EOS
Logical block 0 uses physical slot 4, generation 9; its tail fills first.
After selecting 21: selected count g = 2, but processed N = 4.
To process pending 21 at position 4, prepare logical block 1
Assign physical slot 1, generation 3, from this request’s growth credit.
Candidate table [4,1] is private; published table remains [4] until success.
Success path: all-layer commit N = 5, then select 22
Process 22 at position 5 → N = 6; select EOS and schedule no extra forward.
Final selected history has 4 IDs; KV includes only 6 prompt/processed positions.
Cancellation path before candidate forward commits
Keep published N = 4 and selected history [20,21]; no late 22 may commit.
Drain old-prefix readers and candidate writers before returning their blocks.
Physical slot order is not token order. Terminal closure and safe storage return are separate events.
